title: banner: json-inert; classify the actual creative body and assert visible identity while retaining auction diagnostics.

source.name: IAB OpenRTB 2.5 final specification — Banner, Native and Bid objects
source.notes: All source records are retained in assets/sources.json by reference.sourceIds.

modifications: All auction, bid, creative, site, app and publisher identifiers are synthetic.
All domains use reserved .test names; no real user IDs, IP addresses, consent strings or tracker endpoints.
All text and SVG artwork are original; no public creative copied.
Public example object/asset structure adapted; source values replaced and optional tracking omitted.
device.ip is the documentation-only address 192.0.2.11; OS values describe a synthetic test device.

provenance.sanitized: Only synthetic identifiers, original fixture creatives, reserved domains and TEST-NET addresses. No live tokens, subscriber IDs or real tracking URLs.

specNotes: banner: json-inert; classify the actual creative body and assert visible identity while retaining auction diagnostics.

Creative body classification follows specs/012 §1–2 independently of auction format validity. A visible preview does not make a mismatched response valid. Original base provenance is retained; fixture bytes are synthetic.
